The money did not go to any of her children.

In addition my grandfather had an older brother who had benefited from a more complete education and moved out of the area. The story went that both brothers attempted to hitch a ride on a train, but my grandfather missed the jump, broke his arm as a result, and didn't see his older brother again for many years.

My great uncle found white collar work in another state and eventually worked his way up to a management position. He was able to provide a university education for his sons. One became a professor. The other a literal rocket scientist.
